title: Tableau Prep Failures by Flow
dataSources: Tableau Prep flow runs (`tableau:prep:flow`) and Backgrounder logs.
app: Tableau Prep Conductor flow-run events from the `workgroup` repository via DB Connect and Backgrounder logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:prep:flow finish_code!=0
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by flow_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Tableau Prep failures grouped by flow so operators immediately see which specific flows are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Tableau Prep is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Tableau Prep failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical flows.
visualization: Table of flow by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Tableau Prep are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
